speaker: john_heminges
text: Richard at two. The book on the peg is the cut book. Say that before anyone is noble.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gaunt. I am not asking for a longer part than the book gives me.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You have the dying, and the garden, and the counsel. That is a part. Do not look over the peg for the pages that are not in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three leaves. They stay under the book. I am not playing a deposition this afternoon.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is the cut plot. If a leaf is not on my peg, it is not in the afternoon. I will not be handed a page at the door.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The tally stays shut. This is a book, not a box. Abel, you are not opening Saturday to settle a scene.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The king I play is the king the cut book allows. You will not feed me a speech out of the chest because it is better.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not feed you one. The deposed king stays under the book. He does not walk this afternoon.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then I mark the plot as it stands. No new name. No leaf from the chest. Three is the number I am not to be given.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The boy is not called. Nick is not in this room. The voice holds if he is not startled, and the household has been told. We will not spend Richard on a doublet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody startles him. He is not here to be startled. Arthur's hems are not this morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. I am not a nurse for a hem. You and I have a king to get through, and a Gaunt who must be done before the jig wants the stage.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be done when the book is done. I am not leaving Gaunt in the middle to make the afternoon shorter.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Eight minutes of jig is not my plot. They are not written on my paper.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Cut book. Three leaves in the chest. No surprise tomorrow beyond what we name tomorrow. You said that from Great St Helen's. I am holding you to it here, where it is harder.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You'll have none from me. That was the morning, and it is still true in this room.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You are fond of a page you have promised not to use. I will believe the difference when the chest stays shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then believe it. The chest stays shut. There is no leaf between your king and my Gaunt.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have the plot. I do not have the leaves. If they come out, they come out over my book, and they will not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Gaunt at two. The rest of you know your doors. I am not making a speech about a king we are not playing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We play the king we have. I will be in the gown I already wear for him.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And I in mine. You on your side of the counsel, I on mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No leaf between. I have said it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The hired men's hose can wait for a day when we are looking at hose. Today the book is enough.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Enough is the plot as pegged. I am going to the door. Do not follow me with a fourth leaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not follow you, Abel. Three stay under. Go to your door.
